whatIsItAbout.title: What is the book about?
whatIsItAbout.guide: State what the whole book is about in a single sentence. Then outline its major parts, and name the problems the author set out to solve.

whatDoesItSay.title: What does it say in detail?
whatDoesItSay.guide: The author's key terms, most important propositions, and the arguments behind them. Link your term and concept notes below — that's how you come to terms with the author.

doIAgree.title: Do I agree?
doIAgree.guide: Judge the book. Is the author uninformed (missing something important), misinformed (working from false premises), or illogical (reasoning doesn’t hold)? If none apply, you are obligated to agree — say so.

soWhat.title: So what?
soWhat.guide: If the book is true, what follows? What will you do or think differently? How does it connect with other books you've read?
